title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

14 month Fixed Term Contract

Chelmsford, Essex

Hours 9.00am - 5.30pm

Salary 28,000 - 29,000

Benefits Include : Car Parking on site, 25 days holiday + bank holidays, healthcare support, discounted gym and shopping, generous pension scheme

Are you passionate about human resources and eager to make a difference. Our client, a leading organisation in their sector is seeking a dedicated HR Administrator to join their friendly and approachable team in Chelmsford. This is a fantastic opportunity for an individual who thrives in a fast moving and dynamic environment and is looking to develop their HR career in a supportive and engaging workplace.

About the Role:

As an HR Administrator, you will play a crucial role in supporting the HR team with administrative tasks and processes. This position is perfect for someone who enjoys working collaboratively is detail oriented and enjoys systems management.

What you'll be doing
- Assist in the recruitment process, including posting job adverts, screening candidates, and coordinating interviews.
- Maintain employee records and ensure all HR databases are up to date.
- Support the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the organisation.
- Assist in the preparation of HR reports and documentation.
- Provide administrative support for employee training and development initiatives.

Ideal Candidate:
- Previous experience in an HR administrative role or a strong interest in starting a career in HR.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with HR software is a plus.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Administrator / HR Coordinator

Full-Time Office Based Salary: Up to 32,000 per annum

Join a Growing and People-Focused Business

Are you an organised and proactive HR professional looking to take the next step in your career?

We are seeking an enthusiastic HR Administrator / HR Coordinator to join our busy and supportive HR team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous HR administration experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to broaden their exposure across all areas of Human Resources whilst also supporting payroll activities.

You'll play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of the HR function, providing first-class administrative support and helping to deliver an excellent employee experience throughout the employee lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Supporting the HR team with all aspects of HR administration
- Managing employee records and maintaining accurate HR databases
- Producing employment contracts, offer letters and HR correspondence
- Assisting with onboarding and induction processes for new starters
- Coordinating recruitment activities, including interview scheduling and candidate communication
- Processing HR documentation relating to starters, leavers and employee changes
- Supporting monthly payroll by collating and checking information such as absence, overtime and employee changes
- Monitoring annual leave, sickness and other employee records
- Responding to HR-related queries from employees and managers
- Assisting with HR projects, training coordination and employee engagement initiatives
- Ensuring compliance with company policies and employment legislation

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within an HR Administration, HR Assistant or HR Coordinator role
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Confident handling confidential and sensitive information
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word
- Experience supporting payroll processes would be advantageous
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively in a busy environment
- A positive, proactive and team-focused attitude

What's on Offer?

Salary up to 32,000

Full-time permanent position

Opportunity to gain exposure to all areas of HR

Supportive and collaborative working environment

Ongoing training and career development opportunities

The chance to be part of a growing and successful organisation

Interested?

If you're looking for a varied HR role where no two days are the same and you can make a real impact while developing your career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV to be considered for this exciting opportunity.

title: Recruitment Administration Assistant
description:
Recruitment Administration Assistant

Harlow - Monday to Thursday: 8:00am - 5:00pm Friday: 8:00am - 4:00pm

Berry Recruitment is currently seeking a Recruitment Administration Assistant to join our busy and successful Harlow branch.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive individual looking to develop a career within recruitment and administration. Working as part of a supportive team, you will play a key role in ensuring candidates and clients receive an outstanding service.

Key Responsibilities

Registering new candidates using Tempflow

Ensuring all candidate compliance documentation is completed and maintained accurately on the database

Screening candidates and sourcing new applicants through job boards, social media platforms and branch walk-ins

Reviewing applications and registrations to identify suitable candidates for vacancies

Processing weekly payroll for temporary workers

Setting up new starters and completing onboarding administration

Assisting with client servicing and providing candidate support during periods of annual leave and staff absence

Maintaining accurate records and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the branch

What We're Looking For

Strong administrative and organisational skills

Excellent attention to detail

Confident communication skills, both written and verbal

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment

Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office

Previous administration, customer service or recruitment experience would be advantageous but is not essential

A positive, proactive and team-focused attitude

What We Offer

Competitive salary

Early finish every Friday

Ongoing training and development

Supportive team environment

Career progression opportunities within a well-established recruitment business

If you enjoy working in a busy office environment, have a keen eye for detail and are passionate about delivering excellent customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to join Berry Recruitment and start your recruitment career with a market-leading agency.

We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.
